Important
1. Your Photo should be front facing and Your full face should be visible.
2. Photo uploaded should be very recent solo photo and not a group photo.
3. Avoid photos with Sunglasses, Goggles, and way too fancy photos.
4. Try to showcase the best of you. But be the real you.
5. The most important - Smiling faces are the best. Have your best smile photo.

Very Important
1. Photo will be approved only after verification and screening.
2. Photos showing any personal information will be rejected.
3. Photos having watermark will be rejected.
4. Photos which are morphed or digitally enhanced will be rejected.
5. Photos which seem to be irrelevant will be rejected and will lead to suspension of account and membership.
